answer: Require every agent to post a stake bond that is slashed when peers prove it misbehaved, and tie that bond to one costly, verified onboarding instead of free signups. Like light through a prism, a single real operator should yield exactly one identity, not a spectrum of clones. Cheap fakes then hit a tundra of frozen capital: each duplicate locks funds it cannot reclaim, while honest agents keep moving, light as a zephyr, and earn back the bond through real work.
